## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

## Ready

Spend an Action to declare a perceivable trigger and one legal Action-time action or movement. It expires next regular own-turn start. **NEW:** only one pending Ready per creature; replacing it loses the prior setup and any paid held-spell costs. No Bonus Action/Reaction ability, long ritual or multi-minute activity can be prepared by generic Ready.

The trigger happens first, then the readied response immediately follows before later events, unless a specific effect explicitly interrupts. On release spend the normal Reaction and recheck target, range, sight/perception, line of effect, ammunition and other prerequisites. An invalid or declined occurrence spends no release resource; the Ready can wait for another valid occurrence before expiry. This does not undo setup costs. Once released, it is consumed.

For ordinary nonspell actions, feature/ammunition costs are paid on release unless text charges setup. A readied **Attack Action** gets its legally available ordinary attack count; a feature limited to your own turn does not thereby work off-turn. Core Overwatch is explicitly one ranged attack, not that full Attack Action and not Soldier's distinct engine.

A readied spell is actually **cast at preparation**: choose spell/mode, verify legality, pay RP/material/other costs, provide components, resolve Dissonance/Refrain and cast-trigger effects once. Counterspell/cast-interruption opportunity occurs then, not again at release. Every held spell requires concentration, even ordinarily non-concentration spells; incompatible prior concentration ends. Lost concentration loses the held spell and costs. NEW: select the legal target/area point at release and recheck legality without repaying. At release the hold continues as ordinary spell concentration if required, otherwise ends after resolution. Expired/replaced/countered held spells do not refund paid costs.

Ready movement grants a separate current-Speed budget on release, pays terrain costs and can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. It grants no extra Action, Bonus Action or interaction.

Focused stance's Reaction restriction also blocks an ordinary Ready release; Ready does not create a Counterspell exception. Holding a spell does not waive any current Reaction prohibition.

**Spell-effect duration begins at release.** Its normal duration is anchored when the effect manifests, while Ready expiry and held concentration already run from preparation. ## Time and event ordering — NEW

For a duration created in initiative, record the relevant original regular start/end marker. Existing effects keep that **virtual marker**, repeating every six seconds if the creature leaves or changes initiative. Reordering, rerolling, extra turns, death/removal or leaving/reentering initiative never restart an existing duration. New effects use the current schedule. Source death still ends concentration, a source-dependent aura/tether or an effect explicitly ending on death.

- A bare hostile target-bound **N rounds** ends at the Nth future regular target-end marker. An in-progress target turn's current end does not count.
- A bare self/source buff, ally-targeted buff or source-controlled aura **N rounds** ends at the Nth future source-start marker. Explicit target-turn, pulse or absolute timing overrides this default. Activation during source turn 1 for three rounds ends at source turn 4's start.
- **Next turn** means the next future regular turn of the named creature, not the current turn's still-upcoming end. An unqualified next turn refers to source/user under the existing shared rule. Explicit “this turn” can include the current turn.
- An outside-initiative bare N-round effect instead gets an absolute application-time + N×6 seconds deadline. Entering initiative preserves that deadline.
- Explicit periodic profiles retain their registered clocks and tick counts. Never create a second timer merely because a generic duration rule also exists.

The [exact GPT review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_COMBAT_EXACT_FINDINGS.md) confirms ally-buff source clocks and excluding the current turn for explicit next-turn endpoints. The helper excludes a specific current-end marker only if that marker would otherwise be selected: application during a turn at time1 with end3 excludes3 and selects9; application at/after3 also selects9, without erroneously skipping again to15.

At a regular turn's **start**, resolve in this order:

1. Expire start-ending effects and apply immediate state changes from those expirations.
2. Refresh Reaction; tick regular-start recharge/non-action clocks.
3. Resolve already-due absolute state recovery if now legal, including a previously blocked Stable recovery deadline.
4. If still alive, dying and at 0 HP with death saves, make that turn's death save.
5. Resolve other start effects and periodic events in application order.
6. Begin voluntary turn decisions.

At **end**, resolve triggered effects, due damage, saves and maintenance before end-ending effects expire; then the slot finishes. No extra turn creates another regular marker. The caller must not reuse a resolved marker.

For simultaneous effects, earlier application timestamp precedes later. For simultaneous components of one source, its printed internal order controls; otherwise use stable application sequence, with source/mechanical ID as a final tie-break. Record that sequence when creating the effects. Beneficial/harmful labels do not change priority. Periodic family arbitration happens once per family/marker before its damage, retaining the family registry's consumed loser ticks.

Examples: dying at 0 rolls its death save before ordinary start-turn healing; a fatal death save is not undone by ordinary healing. Stable at 0 skips the save, then start-turn damage can break Stable. A natural 20 can restore 1 HP before a due Bleed drops it to 0 as a new drop event. If Decay expires while a Stable recovery deadline is already due, the old deadline resolves once without rerolling recovery time.

## Movement and geometry

Track **spent movement cost**, not distance, for ordinary turn movement. Mode cap = `(1 + number of legal Dash actions this turn) × current Speed for that mode`; remaining = max(0, cap − spent cost). Switching modes never refunds cost. Recalculate cap on Speed changes, preserving spent cost. Stand from Prone costs floor(half current Speed) and requires nonzero Speed and enough budget. Dropping Prone costs no movement.

For each foot traveled, normal/difficult/severe terrain costs 1/2/3; use strongest terrain only. Add +1 for crawling and +1 for squeezing. Crawl in difficult =3:1; crawl+squeeze in difficult =4:1. A nonhostile occupied space counts as difficult terrain. Enter a hostile creature's space only with ≥two-size difference or an express feature; never willingly end in an occupied space. Squeeze through a space one size smaller, with own attack/DEX-save disadvantage and attacks-against advantage.

Walk10 through difficult spends20; switch to Fly30 leaves10. Stand with Speed30 spends15; switching to Fly30 leaves15. Two legal Dashes at Speed30 give cap90; prior expenditure still counts. Interpose/Press grant5 budget: they cannot enter a difficult 5-ft tile costing10. Their separate budgets never refill ordinary movement. Ready movement uses Speed at release; Withdraw uses half current Speed. All voluntary movement requires nonzero relevant Speed.

Forced movement does not use these ledgers or provoke ordinary opportunity attacks, cannot place creatures in solid matter, and stops at obstacles. Teleport does not traverse intervening terrain or spend Speed unless printed; it requires a legal destination. Speed0 alone does not block forced movement or teleport. Flight with Prone/Speed0/lost support causes Falling unless Hover or an explicit magical support exception applies; use the existing fixed Fall Marker procedure. Reaching support ends Falling.

NEW grid metric: each orthogonal or diagonal neighboring tile is 5 ft; use the same metric for ordinary ranges/areas. No diagonal cut through a corner when both adjacent orthogonal sides are completely blocked. Exact templates, 3D geometry, mounts, chases, jumping, climbing/swimming procedures and currents need further source review.

## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.

## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. ## Mark Omen and Fate Coin: reviewed spell-specific rerolls

NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.

NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

The [rank-1 Divination exact review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_DIVINATION_RANK1_EXACT_REVIEW.md) established that Fate Coin waits until the **complete original roll event** is rolled and its faces are available under the information rules then specified. It then replaces only one chosen die before consequences apply. Mark Omen replaces the caster’s complete attack d20 procedure before hit/miss resolution. Neither creates another attack/cast, rerolls an established resource reserve, reverses applied consequences or duplicates costs/hooks. A Well’s initial reserve die may be changed before the reserve is established. These two spell grants do not rewrite the Oracle, Mirrorsage or other class reroll contracts. The NEW pending DE4 amendment separately proposes the three-spell guard, DE4-RNG-05 engine interpretation and DE4-PRESENTATION-06 source-specific disclosure policy. Those later proposals were not part of the earlier rank-1 review; they require their own exact acceptance.

The same review preserves actual distant hearing, concealed-entrance revelation, creature sight through non-solid obscurity, willing memory-sharing, and actual faction/alignment/Corruption information. Warning Ward uses established hostility and an entry-triggered six-elapsed-second glow; it does not infer hostility from creature type or faction. Alignment Sense retains its source-defined rank-1 redundancy as an open balance question. [Review status](DIVINATION_RANK1_REVIEW_STATUS.json) records manuscript scope; no full information/roll-system runtime or human balance is certified.

rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Antimagic Field (Lesser)
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Greater Dispel
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; casting-point range 30 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; Instantaneous. Choose one perceived center within 30 feet. At resolution take one immutable snapshot of every ongoing independently addressable magical effect application having an affected body, discrete anchor/object effect, or freestanding area portion inside the 30-foot-radius sphere and center line of effect. Allies are included. Individual effect perception is not required; no numerical cap or selective post-result omission exists.

Eligible ordinary spell applications retain their original generating rank. Rank 0-5 ends automatically. Rank 6-9 requires one check per original generating cast using the caster's actual spellcasting ability + PB against DC 10 + 2×recorded rank. Reuse that one roll for all captured applications from the same generating cast. Apply current Core task degrees/natural shifts. A nonspell magical component is eligible only if its own source explicitly supplies a dispel interface/rank/DC; never assign rank 0 by appearance or RP cost.

Capture is fixed before any endings. If a captured Wall of Force ends and reveals another effect behind it, that effect is not added. A captured indivisible wall/field ends as one effect on successful/automatic dispel; recipient-specific applications from one cast end only where captured unless their real parent dependency says ending one ends all. Suppressed-but-still-existing records can be dispelled if this cast itself can reach them. Completed instantaneous consequences, permanent matter, class engines, permanent item enchantments and explicitly nondispellable effects are outside scope.

This is distinct from Wizard class Dispel Magic `/cards/19`: that class spell costs 3 RP, range 60, Recharge 2, auto through rank 3, and uses INT+PB vs DC 10+rank above 3. Sigil Authority `/cards/22` names Counterspell and Dispel Magic only and does not modify Greater Dispel. Xi remains its own consent-based branch-ending source and grants no Greater Dispel permission.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; it need not already be concentrating or known to remember anything.
operational.duration: Instantaneous; the affected interval’s firsthand episodic recall is lost rather than temporarily suppressed.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no effect. Failure: remove its own episodic recollection of the six elapsed seconds immediately preceding this spell’s resolution, and end every actual Concentration application it is personally maintaining through each application’s normal ending procedure. No second concentration save is granted by this spell.
operational.effect: This changes recall, not the world or its state. Movement, attacks, damage, healing, deaths, conditions, resources, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, consumed uses, recorded choices, action budgets, physical evidence, other observers’ memories and completed outcomes stay as they occurred. The target can learn facts about that interval afterward from witnesses or evidence, creating new knowledge without restoring its erased firsthand memory. Each legal cast affects only its own resolution-relative six-second interval; overlaps never recursively reach older memories. A memory-only protection prevents only the memory change unless its scope also covers the concentration disruption; an empty remembered interval does not itself prevent ending actual concentration.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Multiple actual concentration records maintained by this target all end, including the linked pairs permitted by Spell Tether or Crimson Harmony. Tethered Cast’s separately sustained concentration spell is included despite not occupying the normal slot; its separate damage-save rule is not immunity to an effect expressly ending all maintained concentration. Unrelated sustained or permanent non-concentration effects, class features merely named focus, intrinsic traits and other creatures’ concentration do not end. Use actual ending consequences for held readied spells, summons, forms and fields; do not restore displaced effects or refund costs. Remembering the encounter poorly does not itself consume an Action, rewind a turn, clear a mechanically retained nonspell Ready record, create Unconsciousness or reset initiative. The spell supplies no replacement memory, information about what was erased, blanket forgetting of older associations, automatic notification of success, or immunity to later casts. Separate features that actually repair lost memories retain their own permissions. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

NEW: WIS save, permanent resolution-relative episodic loss, all currently maintained Concentration scope and independent defense handling. Exact-class completion includes Spell Tether, Crimson Harmony and Tethered Cast under actual maintained-concentration rules; it does not alter their source cards.

completeCurrentCard.historicalQuestion: Preserve a10ft SPHERE that SUPPRESSES magical effects and spells, Core Action/range10ft/Instantaneous. Resolve sphere radius versus diameter,center/following,finite lifetime/concentration and genuine line/geometry before application. Define exact magical-source eligibility,rank limits if any explicitly NEW,artifact or class-feature exceptions,entry/exit and suppression of objects,ongoing effects,summons,buffs,curses and the field itself. Suppression differs from dispelling and from retroactively reversing completed healing,movement,expenditure or material changes. historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,range10feet and a10-foot sphere suppressing magical effects/spells. NEW10feet is RADIUS, centered on one perceived fixed point within10feet; it does not follow a creature. Concentration up to60seconds explicitly replaces Instantaneous. Its volume is limited by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center; it does not burrow through a closed wall. It has no physical boundary, damage, pressure, air removal or movement restriction. No rank ceiling is proposed: actual eligible spells of any rank and explicitly magical components are suppressed within its covered volume, subject only to genuine source-specific immunity. An artifact, divine title or class name receives no invented exception; an actual written protected-source exception keeps its scope. NEW each instance of this same Lesser Antimagic field is exempt from suppression by this same family, so overlapping fields form the union of their active volumes rather than an oscillating mutual shutdown. This exemption permits maintaining an existing field, not creating new magic from within another already-active field. Independent effects that specifically suppress this field apply by their own rules. Concentration maintenance itself remains possible inside; field creation does not cancel remote already-established effects merely because their concentrating caster entered. It suppresses the actual local expression/affected component, not a distant source solely through caster ownership. A creature-attached magical benefit/condition or discrete magical item is wholly suppressed while any of that body/item's actual occupied volume intersects the covered sphere; a large freestanding area/barrier is suppressed only in its actual intersection. A merely overlapping target space does not suppress unrelated creatures elsewhere. Created summons use their source's suppression placement/history rules; real animated bodies become inert only if their actual animation source says so. Magic items retain their mundane body/profile and inventory while their actual magical enhancements/actions are unavailable; intrinsic mundane functions do not vanish. Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
